correctness.rationale: On the lift to Z, visited positions form [m_t,M_t], so C_n first becomes covered precisely when its range reaches n-1; final new vertex is the newly reached end. Positive drift ensures finite attained global minimum -J, after which all large-cycle cover events are new maximum H_{n-1-J}. Gambler ruin gives P(J>=j)=(q/p)^j. The ladder increments H_b-H_{b-1} are iid with mean 1/(p-q), variance 4pq/(p-q)^3 and an exponential moment. The CLT for H_n transfers to T_n because a geometric-tight random terminal offset changes time only O_P(1). To show independence, truncate J to its finite-time minimum J_m, invoke the Markov property for the future long first passage, and let m grow after n. Independently tested cycle cover/range identity on 100 deterministic path-cycle pairs; not a proof of the infinite statement.
